author.1:
Every page of the Distribution File carries a footer: f = 111.2 Hz.

Archaeoacousticians have documented resonance near 110 Hz in Neolithic chambers from Malta to Scotland. The extra decimal is the fiction signing its own work.

author.2:
Chladni, 1787: bow a sand-covered plate and the sand maps the silence.

Jenny found that shifting from 800 to 865 cycles transforms the pattern categorically.

The novels add one claim: the geometry remakes the observer. That is mine.

jasoncholloway.com/blog/sound-into-form-hans-jenny/
author.3:
Why Kansas City? Convenience, then something stranger.

Hopewell stone-vault tombs, two thousand years old. The Osage concept of Wah-kon-tah. A 63-acre temple lot dedicated 1831, never built, still mowed.

The gap: no acoustics study of the KC underground.

jasoncholloway.com/blog/why-kansas-city/
author.4:
The Ars Notoria is real. British Library, MS Sloane 1712.

It promised the liberal arts via geometric contemplation. Condemned not for devil-worship but for cheating: knowledge without sanctioned labor.

What I invented: that it works.

jasoncholloway.com/blog/the-grimoire-that-was-a-study-aid/
author.5:
An early draft called the cathedral limestone. It's red brick, 1882. The research pass caught me.

Westport Presbyterian burned in 2011. Roof gone. Interior gone. The 1904 limestone walls stood.

"The stone remembers" was written before I found the fire.

jasoncholloway.com/blog/the-stone-remembers/
author.6:
In 1984 American intelligence translated a Chinese journal on paranormal research and filed it. One government published. The other classified the act of reading.

That asymmetry is the politics of my trilogy.

jasoncholloway.com/blog/three-factions-one-declassified-document/
author.7:
My conspiracy trilogy ends with a license. 247 pages, midnight, CC0.

The intuitive opposite of classification is leaking. The actual opposite is making the work boring: documented, reproducible, free.

jasoncholloway.com/blog/a-document-that-cannot-be-unreleased/
